title: Interactive Gungeon Meter — Coolness/Curse Fill Bar
items: FEATURE: Interactive Gungeon Meter — custom-painted horizontal fill bar replacing the old LinearProgressIndicator on the stats detail screen. Animated gradient fill (cyan for coolness, oxblood-red for curse). Threshold tick at 10 with prominent marker. Tap or drag anywhere on the bar to set the value directly. Overflow state at curse ≥ 10: pulsing red glow border + skull icon at the right edge + Lord of the Jammed alert card. Haptic feedback on threshold cross. Scale labels (0/5/10/15+) with threshold highlight. RepaintBoundary isolated for performance.

title: Active Run Rework Phase 5 — Preferences Sheet + Polish
items: FEATURE: Display Preferences sheet — gear icon on the mode bar opens a bottom sheet with display mode picker (3 cards with descriptions), 2.5D inventory toggle, and tilt intensity slider (0-100%). Changes apply live behind the sheet. Dark container + grabber styling matches existing customization sheets.
POLISH: Mode bar collapsed pill now has a separate gear icon for quick access to preferences without expanding the full mode picker.

title: Active Run Rework Phase 4 — Gungeon Matrix Mode
items: FEATURE: Gungeon Matrix Mode — purple digital rain background with active run data overlaid in glassmorphic panels. Character portrait in a circular terminal frame with scanning line animation. Stats as a vertical data readout panel (monospace purple). Guns + items as horizontal scrolling data stream chips with DepthTile 2.5D. Central focus panel for top-DPS gun with purple glow. Rain capped at 24x18 glyphs, DPR-aware column reduction. All three display modes now live.

title: Active Run Rework Phase 3 — Compact Run Mode
items: FEATURE: Compact Run Mode — tactical HUD layout for mid-fight glances. Top strip: character name + inline stat chips (COOL/CURSE/GUNS/ITEMS/TOP DPS). Middle: 2-column grid — left guns (icon + name + DPS), right items (icon + name + recharge). ~6 rows visible, overflow opens a scrollable sheet. No section headers, no sort pickers. Top-DPS gun gets gold left-border accent. DepthTile 2.5D with flatter tilt. Dense monospace neon aesthetic.

title: Active Run Rework Phase 2 — Mode Switcher + Codex Book
items: FEATURE: Run Display Mode Bar — collapsible mode switcher on the active run screen. Three preview cards (Codex Book / Compact Run / Gungeon Matrix). Tap to switch instantly. Collapsed by default to a single pill; tap to expand. Persisted collapse state.

FEATURE: Codex Book Mode — leather-and-brass compendium layout. Left page: character portrait in a brass locket frame + stats cards. Right page: swipeable Guns / Items / Synergies pages with page-turn chevrons. Responsive: two-page spread on wide screens, stacked on narrow. 2.5D DepthTile on every row. Top-DPS gun gets gold accent. Synergy glow preserved.

title: Ambient Fragment Shaders — GPU Digital Rain & Dark Neon Fog
items: FEATURE: Ambient fragment shaders — GPU-composited visual effects rendered via GLSL fragment programs. Two presets: Digital Rain (purple Matrix-style falling glyph columns) and Dark Neon Fog (slow-churning purple-black fog). Opt-in via VisualPrefs, rendered behind content with RepaintBoundary isolation.
INFRA: FragmentProgram.fromAsset loads .frag files at startup, cached at class level for instant switching. Stopwatch-driven uTime uniform, AnimationController drives repaint ticks only.

title: Synergy Predictor — Find Items That Complete Synergies
items: FEATURE: Synergy Predictor — browse items and guns now show a gold 'COMPLETES' badge when acquiring them would activate a partial synergy. Shows the synergy name for single completions, or a count for multiple. No UI clutter — only appears when the item would actually complete something.

title: True One-Tap Co-op for Paired Partners
items: FEATURE: True one-tap connect — tap a paired partner and you're in. No role picker, no character picker, no PIN. The app remembers your last role and character for each partner and connects immediately.
UX: First-time connect still shows the role/character dialog (so you pick Host/Join + character once). After that, every subsequent connect is a single tap.
UX: Long-press a paired partner to change role or character — for when you want to switch sides.

title: Device Pairing Phase 2 — Elevated Privileges
items: FEATURE: Faster auto-reconnect for paired partners — paired sessions use a 10s backoff cap (vs 30s regular) and 0.5s initial retry (vs 1s). Your regular co-op partner gets priority reconnection.
FEATURE: Character swap flexibility for paired Sidekicks — paired partners joining as Sidekick can now pick any gungeoneer, not just The Cultist. Character picker appears in the connect dialog.

FEATURE: 'Reset Run with New Gungeoneer' — paired Main players can reset their run with a different character without disconnecting the pair. Button appears on the connect screen when connected as paired Main. No re-pairing needed.

title: Device Pairing — One-Tap Co-op with Regular Partners
items: FEATURE: Pair a Partner — one-time setup for instant co-op with a regular partner. Pair once via a 4-digit pairing PIN, then connect with one tap every time after. No PIN exchange needed on subsequent sessions.
FEATURE: Paired Partners list in the multiplayer lobby — tap any paired partner to connect instantly as Host or Sidekick. Shows partner nickname and last connected time.
FEATURE: Pairing uses a persistent 8-character secret (pairId) exchanged automatically over Nearby Connections. Stored locally via SharedPreferences — no servers, no accounts, fully device-to-device.
INFRASTRUCTURE: New PairedPartner model + PairedPartnersStore (ValueNotifier-backed SharedPreferences persistence). Mirrors the HomeCustomization pattern.
INFRASTRUCTURE: New MpPair + MpPairAck wire messages for the one-time pairing token exchange. Protocol version unchanged (still v1) — backwards compatible.

INFRASTRUCTURE: MultiplayerSession pairing mode — startPairing/joinPairing/connectPaired methods. Pairing mode skips run-state side effects (no snapshot broadcast, no session persistence during pairing).

title: ✨ Particle Engine v2 — 6 Visual Upgrades
items: ✨ Lifetime system: particles fade in at birth, fade out at death, then respawn at new positions. Removes the jarring wrap 'pop'. Each particle has a 2-14s lifespan depending on preset.

✨ Color drift: particles slowly cycle hue over time for living, breathing color palettes. Forge embers shift through warm tones, cosmic dust cycles blue-violet, rainbow confetti rotates through the full spectrum.
✨ Turbulence field: pseudo-curl-noise perturbs particle velocity for organic, swirling movement. Cursed smoke billows, toxic bubbles wobble, void rifts swirl — no more straight-line-only drift.

✨ Gradient line links: connections between particles now use a color gradient (particle A's color → particle B's color) with thickness varying by proximity. Richer visual network for cosmic stars, void rifts, jam hexes.

✨ Depth-of-field: far particles (low depth) get subtle blur, near particles stay sharp. Creates parallax depth perception. Improved breathing: dual-oscillator (1.5Hz + 0.7Hz) with 16% amplitude — more visible size variation.
✨ Shimmer: periodic brightness sweep — particles randomly flash 2x brighter then dim back. Stars twinkle, golden sparkles gleam, frost shards catch the light, heart containers beat.
✨ Trails: moving particles leave fading trails behind them. Forge embers streak, bullet hell leaves bullet trails, cursed smoke wisps, master rounds leave smokey fall trails.
✨ Organic rotation: rotational acceleration + damping instead of constant speed. Shapes spin up, slow down, reverse — more natural than mechanical rotation.
✨ All 18 presets tuned with appropriate upgrade combinations. Refactored shape drawing to eliminate duplicated code.

title: ✨ Experience Studio — Mini Particle Engine in Preview

🔗 Multiplayer reconnect now announces itself — a floating 'Connection restored — sync resumed' snackbar fires with a success haptic the moment the link comes back, instead of silently closing the drop dialog. Teardowns (disconnect/cancel) stay quiet so you only hear from it on a real recovery.

✨ Quality tier cleanup — 36 entries across guns (19) and items (17) were showing '1S' instead of 'S' in UI metadata chips, a data-pipeline artifact. All corrected to 'S'; the Browse quality-sort special case simplified.

🧹 Removed the Multiplayer Summary tab from the MP header — the P1/P2 header is now cleaner with just the two player tabs. The Summary page code is left dormant on disk for potential future re-introduction.

The palette selector no longer requires horizontal scrolling — all 6 palettes are visible in a wrap layout. ParticleField gained a colorsOverride param for per-palette color injection without bloating the preset enum.

🖤 S-tier quality badge reverted to its documented design — black pill, white letter, animated golden glow. The gold-pill drift (white-on-gold, low contrast) is gone. The S chest chip label and icon are now white instead of dark-on-dark, so 'Chest S' is actually readable.

🔫 Periodic grid gun tiles reworked — gun type (Pistol/Shotgun/Rifle/Beam/etc.) now sits as a centered subtitle below the item name instead of a tiny corner tag. RANGE is now shown alongside DPS in the bottom-center badge. Tile aspect ratio bumped from 0.80 to 0.75 to fit the new subtitle row.

⚙️ Settings merged — the old 3-tab Settings (VISUALS / RUN / APP) is now 2 tabs (VISUALS / RUN & APP). The Run & App tab uses a compact 2-column grid of icon+label action tiles grouped into RUN SESSION, INVENTORY & DATA, and DANGER ZONE. The dialogue card (haptics + text speed) stays full-width at the top. Old AppTab left dormant on disk.

📊 Stat-group tags upgraded — Combat / Handling / Meta labels in the gun detail screen are now bigger (15px, w800) and color-coded. Each group gets a signature accent color (Combat=red, Handling=cyan, Meta=amber by default) that themes can override to match their palette. Filled-pill header for filled-chip themes, accent-bar for minimalist themes. Stat pills in each group get a subtle label tint in the group color.

🎨 Theme + particle picking streamlined — every visible theme now auto-binds a curated particle preset (Forge Master→embers, Robot's Core→casings, Custom→cosmic stars) instead of only Unicorn getting particles. The theme picker has a quick-access strip of 5 tappable theme circles (no more swiping through all 5 full-screen pages) and a horizontal particle preset strip for instant effect switching. Applying a theme now returns you to where you launched from instead of kicking you to the home screen. A palette quick-launch button (pink icon) replaces the old Settings gear on the main menu top-right corner.

🔢 Periodic grid gun badges now show unit labels — DPS values display as '56.0 DMG' and range values as '1000 RNG' instead of bare numbers. Labels are smaller and dimmer than the values so the numbers stay the primary visual element.

🏷️ Active-run header icons now have text labels — the 4 toggle icons (Damage Calculator, Effects, Shrine, Special Panels) each show a tiny label below ('Calc', 'Effects', 'Shrine', 'Panels') so new users can tell what each icon does without tapping blindly. Labels match the icon color (amber when ON, dim when OFF).

✨ S-tier readability fixed on all backgrounds — S-tier quality pills, game icon rings, and chest chips now use gold accents (border, text, glow) instead of near-black, which was invisible on dark panels. title: 🔁 MP RECONNECTION OVERHAUL: 10 BUG FIXES
items: PIN Code Persistence (CRITICAL): The MP session PIN is now saved to SharedPreferences and restored on app-kill recovery. Without this, the Main generated a new random PIN on restart and the Sidekick's endpoint filter silently rejected it — reconnection after app-kill was impossible.

RunState Restoration on App-Kill (CRITICAL): tryRestorePersistedSession now loads the full RunState (inventory, coolness, curse, shrines) from the most recent saved_mp_sessions entry, not just the role/character identity. Survives app-kill with zero data loss.

Sidekick Pre-MP State Persistence (HIGH): The Sidekick's pre-MP solo run snapshot is now persisted to disk and restored on app-kill recovery. Without this, cancel() after restore would overwrite the real pre-MP state with MP state.
Cancel Clears Reconnect Identity (CRITICAL): cancel() now clears _lastRole and _lastCharacter so canReconnect returns false. Prevents a PINless reconnect() call after cancel() zeroes the PIN.

State-Drift Protection During Disconnect (HIGH): Inventory mutations (addGun, removeGun, addItem, removeItem) are now blocked while MP is disconnected. Prevents local state drift that would overwrite the peer's correct state on reconnect.

FIX LINK Now Saves Before Reconnecting (MEDIUM): The FIX LINK button calls fullReconnectCycle() which saves the session to disk before restarting transport, guaranteeing a fresh restore point exists before teardown.
Connection Restored Popup (MEDIUM): A themed green SnackBar now appears when auto-reconnect succeeds, confirming the link is back so users don't have to guess.
Reconnect Attempt Count in Drop Dialog (MEDIUM): The connection-lost dialog now shows the live auto-retry attempt number so users know the system is actively trying.
Log NotifyListeners Debounced (MEDIUM): _log() now coalesces notifyListeners() calls via scheduleMicrotask, preventing 3-4 redundant UI rebuilds per auto-reconnect attempt.

MpError Triggers Auto-Reconnect (LOW): Transport errors (MpError events) now transition to disconnected state and start auto-reconnect, instead of leaving the session in a stale connected state with an error string.

Now correctly detected and filled in on both new-style and legacy-style wiki pages.

title: 🌍 ROOT-CAUSE FIX: EXIT-THE-GUNGEON DATA CONTAMINATION
items: Wiki Scraper Root Cause Fix: The wiki.gg infobox scraper (enrich_from_wikigg.py) was silently gluing Enter the Gungeon stats together with Exit the Gungeon (and other game-mode toggle) stats into a single string whenever a stat had multiple tabs on the wiki page. Fixed the parser to always extract ETG-only values, while carefully preserving legitimate in-game state toggles (like AC-15's Armored/Unarmored stats, which are both real ETG data).

22 Guns Repaired: A.W.P., AK-47, Alien Sidearm, Anvillain, Balloon Gun, Bee Hive, Big Iron, Big Shotgun, Blasphemy, Blunderbuss, Brick Breaker, Cold 45, Grenade Launcher, H4mmer, Jolter, Pitchfork, Regular Shotgun, and Void Core Assault Rifle had 78 corrupted fields (damage, fire rate, magazine size, ammo capacity, reload time, shot speed, range, force, spread, and type) silently mixing in Exit the Gungeon values — all now cleaned to Enter the Gungeon-only data.

Full Re-Verification: All 239 guns re-audited after the fix. 235/239 confirmed clean automatically; the remaining 4 are non-issues (wiki displays an infinity symbol instead of text for 3, and Heroine's charge-level labels were already correctly fixed in a prior update).

title: 🐻 NECKBEAR'S APPROVAL + CAT GONE + BG FIX
items: Cat Throne Overlay Removed: The secret Cat Bullet King Throne screen-peek widget is gone for good, no more surprise overlays.
Broken Still Wallpapers Fixed: Removed 28 phantom Still Wallpaper entries that pointed at image files which never existed on disk — Custom Still mode is hidden until real art ships.

Neckbear's Approval Medal: Every one of the 239 guns has been checked stat-by-stat against the official wiki and stamped with a cute bear medal 🐻 shown on both the Browse list and Gun Detail screen. All 239 passed — zero real mismatches found (3 wiki-tab parsing false-positives confirmed already correct from prior fixes).

title: 🐛 CAT THRONE WHITE SCREEN — ROOT CAUSE FOUND
items: Cat Bullet King Throne White Overlay Fix: The secret _CuriousCatStareWidget used a Positioned widget directly inside AnimatedBuilder (not a Stack), so its width/height constraints were ignored and the cat image was stretched to fill the entire screen as a semi-transparent white overlay. Now wrapped in a Stack so Positioned works correctly — the cat peeks from the bottom-right corner as intended.

title: 🐛 WHITE SCREEN FIX — SCAFFOLD TRANSPARENCY
items: White Opaque Screen Fix: Root cause identified as scaffoldBackgroundColor in AppTheme.themeFor() being 90% opaque when hypnoticBg was disabled. This obscured ThemeOverlay backgrounds (wallpapers, particles, galaxy) on any screen without explicit transparent Scaffold. Now always transparent — ThemeOverlay provides the base solid color via its own Container layer.

Full Screen Audit: All 10+ pushed screens (Multiplayer Lobby, Multiplayer Connect, Synergies Overview, Stats Detail, Shrine Picker, Item Detail, Favourites, Effects Summary, Character Select, HomeScreen loading/error states) now explicitly set backgroundColor: Colors.transparent on both Scaffold and AppBar.

title: 🐛 VISUAL POLISH — PARALLAX, OVERLAY, WIND ARTIFACTS, THEME BG
items: Smooth Parallax: Converted still wallpaper background to a StatefulWidget with AnimationController for buttery 60fps exponential lerp of gyroscope tilt values. No more sensor jitter or low FPS.

Quick Add Overlay Fix: Fixed race condition where a bright white overlay appeared when quick-adding items. Now uses FocusManager unfocus + PostFrameCallback to sequence modal dismissal before navigation.

Wind Path Artifacts Removed: Eliminated wobbly 'wind current' bezier curve rendering from all particle backdrops (Gold Dust, Hellfire, Cosmic Rift, Custom Particles). No more ghostly lines drifting upward.
Lingering Background Fix: ThemePickerScreen Scaffold was opaque (90% alpha), hiding ThemeOverlay backgrounds during preview and causing a flash when popping. Now transparent like all other screens.

items: Robot Dashboard Redesign: Fixed font overflow on junk toggles. Gold Junk and Lies toggles are now bigger, more compact tap targets with icon + label + subtitle layout. DMG boost badge is now larger and more prominent.

Per-Theme Preview Data: All 21 themes now have custom stats, bullet notes, and subheadings that showcase their palette identity with real Gungeon flavor.

title: ⚡ PARTICLE SYSTEM OVERHAUL, FPS FIX & PARALLAX REWORK
items: Elemental Particle Types: Completely reworked the custom particle type system to 7 distinct elemental types — Fire (embers & sparks), Water (bubbles & droplets), Earth (dust & stone pebbles), Air (wind gusts & streaks), Bullets (golden shells & brass casings), Gunpowder (smoke puffs & muzzle flash sparks), and Stars (cosmic sparkles with white cores). Removed all old emoji-based particles (necromantic skulls, skeletal bones, tombstone crosses, rainbow prismatic, frost, toxic, lightning, gold/brass/steel).

Massive FPS Optimization: Removed all expensive MaskFilter.blur calls from particle painters (curse fog, sparkles, hellfire, gold dust wind, cosmic rift wind). Replaced curse fog's blur(45) with cheap RadialGradient shaders. Replaced sparkle glow halos with cheap concentric alpha-gradient circles. Added RepaintBoundary to custom particle backdrop. Removed Gun_Fairy.webp async asset load that was wasting memory.

Particle Cutoff Fix: Removed all modulo wrapping (% size.height, % size.width) from particle position calculations across all 10+ backdrop painters. Particles now travel fully off-screen before fading out instead of wrapping around abruptly.

Parallax Rework for Large Screens: Increased accelerometer clamp range from ±6 to ±10 and smoothing factor from 0.12 to 0.18 for more responsive tilt. Still wallpaper parallax now scales by screen dimensions (screenSize.width * 0.015) instead of fixed 3.8px, so bigger phones get proportional movement. Lowered image filter quality to low for better FPS.

items: Unicorn Bubblegum Theme Visual Rework: Completely reworked the sparkle particle painter with a 6-color pastel palette (hot pink, lavender, mint cyan, soft pink, amethyst, white), dual-layer glow halos with MaskFilter blur, three distinct shape varieties (4-point star, glowing bubble, 6-point double-star), and bright white cores for a premium magical cotton-candy aesthetic.
